title: D-Mart Q2FY27 result: Net profit rises 8.5% to ₹743 cr, revenue grows 17.8%
description:
Avenue Supermarts Ltd, which owns and operates the retail chain D-Mart, has reported an increase of 8.5 per cent in consolidated net profit at Rs 742.98 crore for the September quarter, on a year-on-year basis.
The company had posted a net profit of Rs 684.85 crore in the July-September quarter a year ago, according to a regulatory filing from Avenue Supermarts.
Its revenue from operations was up 17.8 per cent to Rs 19,644 crore during the quarter under review. It was at Rs 16,676.30 crore in the corresponding quarter in the last fiscal year.
Total expenses of Avenue Supermarts during the September quarter were up 18.3 per cent to Rs 18,632.70 crore.
Avenue Supermarts' total income, which includes other income, was at Rs 19,657.54 crore, up 17.73 per cent in the September quarter.
In the first half (H1/FY27) Avenue Supermarts' total income was at Rs 38,477.85 crore, up 16.47 per cent.
